AdaptixC2_2026-03-04_mingw_x64_stub_x64.build_flags: MinGW GCC, flags not published (committed upstream)
AdaptixC2_2026-03-04_mingw_x64_stub_x64.notes: The loader shellcode upstream commits and its Go teamserver prepends to every built beacon DLL, taken as committed. The beacon agent itself is not built: src_beacon/Makefile has no link rule, the link needs a generated operator payload configuration, and upstream's link line strips symbols. Nothing is executed and no payload is configured.
